newsitem.title: ROMANIA: World Bank agrees $625 mln in Romania credits.
newsitem.headline: World Bank agrees $625 mln in Romania credits.

text.p: The World Bank will provide $625 million in credits to Romania in 1997, much more than earlier proposals, Bank President James Wolfensohn said.
Wolfensohn said on Monday after talks with Romania's new centrist leadership that the credits reflected confidence in the government reform programme launched in February.

They included $350 million for an Agricultural Structural Adjustment Loan (ASAL), $50 million to underpin social programmes, $150 million to upgrade roads, $50 million for higher education and $25 million to improve water supplies.
A further $80 million was likely to be approved within a week under resumed disbursement of an earlier Financial and Enterprise Structural Adjustment Loan (FESAL).
